properties.description: Built 2026-10-23, PR A2 (feat/claims-and-shared-premises). mirror_surface refreshes in place: local edges into still-published nodes survive; a withdrawn node is kept with `superseded_by_surface`/`superseded_at`, a snapshot (epoch:preserved-on-write) and one deprecation ChangeEvent; the reply lists `superseded`, `kept_edges`, `snapshots`, `change_event`. The guard counts every local edge touching a withdrawn node either way round (PREMISE_OF included; signatures and bookkeeping excluded) and refuses unless `accept_withdrawal: true`. A withdrawn mirrored node reads unknown ("superseded: withdrawn by …"); what rests on it lists `rests_on_withdrawn` in reasoning_report and counts in loop_status `reasons_lost` (with `premises_withdrawn`) until re-grounded or let go (dropped/superseded/rejected); propagate_from seeds from it. A requirement another `replaces` reads proof_status/statement_reading `superseded` (not contested) and published_promises leaves it out. Measured on the split-capstone KESTREL-ASSESS v1/v2 surfaces: 0.90.0 deleted KJ1–KJ4 and every local edge, reasons_lost 0, unknown_seeds; this build keeps all four, 3 decisions read reason-lost.
properties.name: A refreshed mirror keeps what its source withdrew, marked superseded, keeps every local edge, refuses to withdraw a premise unless accepted, and what rested on it reads reason-lost; a judgment replaced by `replaces` reads superseded and is not published
